facts.statement: In-game Summer Camp events were expected Tuesdays at 09:00 and 16:00 Pacific time, Thursdays at 15:00 Pacific time, and Fridays at 09:00 Pacific time.
facts.quote: todos los martes a las 09:00 hrs. y 16:00 hrs. TP (tiempo pacifico), y los jueves a las 15:00 hrs. tiempo pacifico y los viernes por la mañana a las 09:00 hrs.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Campamento de Verano – Semana de Moda / Summer Camp – Fashion Week)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post for the Summer Camp community event, themed as Fashion Week, with fashion shows and friend activities during the week. It gives the expected in-game event times (Tuesday, Thursday and Friday) and explains how to reach events through the Game Guide calendar and its Go button. The post is undated; it was posted about 11 months before the 2011-06-04 capture.
